svg.aria-label: A flatbed scanner, a die and a tape typewriter on one bench plate. The scan head passes over a printed page; a die comes down on the structure drawing, capsaicin, and lifts it out of the page; a flag rises on the column for the classifier; then the typewriter types the SMILES COc1cc(CNC(=O)CCCC/C=C/C(C)C)ccc1O on a paper tape.
